# Code Printer

> Browser-only source code printing for A4/PDF. No server upload.

## When to use

- Print or save source code as PDF with syntax highlighting
- Keep code 100% local (nothing sent to servers)
- A4 layout preview with 1/2 columns and manual page breaks

## Quick start

1. Open the app (`/`).
2. Paste code into the editor or use `window.codePrinter.apply({ code: "..." })`.
3. Adjust settings via URL query or Agent API (below).
4. Print with Ctrl+P / Cmd+P (enable background graphics, minimum margins).

## URL parameters

| Param | Values | Description |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `ui` | `ko`, `en` | UI language |
| `lang` | `javascript`, `python`, `java`, `csharp`, `cpp`, `html`, `css`, `sql`, `plaintext` | Syntax highlighting |
| `font` | `D2Coding`, `Consolas`, `CourierNew`, `UbuntuMono` | Font family key |
| `size` | number | Font size (pt) |
| `spacing` | number | Letter spacing (px) |
| `lineHeight` | number | Line height multiplier |
| `cols` | `1`, `2` | Column layout |
| `margin` | `default`, `none`, `minimum`, `custom` | Margin preset |
| `mt`, `mb`, `ml`, `mr` | number (mm) | Custom margins |
| `find` | `1` | Open find/replace panel |
| `panel` | `none`, `style`, `paper` | Preview panel state |

## URL hash (code)

- `#code=<base64url>` — initial editor content (client-side only)

Example: `/?lang=python&cols=2&font=D2Coding#code=...`

## Routes

- `/` — editor
- `/help` — help

## External links

- Creator hub: https://ddunddun-hub.sysscalper.workers.dev/
- GitHub Issues: https://github.com/ddunddun-labs/code-printer/issues

## Agent API (`window.codePrinter`)

Available after page load. All operations stay in the browser.

```javascript
// Read state
window.codePrinter.getState();

// Update settings and/or code
window.codePrinter.apply({
  syntaxLang: 'python',
  style: { fontFamilyKey: 'D2Coding', fontSize: 10 },
  paper: { columns: 2, marginPreset: 'minimum' },
  code: 'print("hello")',
});

// Actions
window.codePrinter.run('undo');
window.codePrinter.run('insertPageBreak');
window.codePrinter.run('replaceAll');
window.codePrinter.run('quickClean', { type: 'removeEmptyLines' });
window.codePrinter.run('loadFile', { name: 'app.py', content: '...' });
window.codePrinter.run('print', { skipModal: true });
window.codePrinter.run('navigate', { view: 'help' });

// Subscribe to changes
window.codePrinter.subscribe(() => console.log(window.codePrinter.getState()));
```

## PAGE_BREAK marker

Exact line (manual page break):

```
%%%%%%%%%% PAGE_BREAK %%%%%%%%%%
```

## Print checklist

- Browser print margins: **None** or **Minimum**
- Enable **Background graphics** for syntax colors

## Limitations

- No server-side PDF API (privacy by design)
- `window.print()` may require user gesture in some browsers
- Syntax theme is fixed (GitHub style)
- Very long code in URL hash may hit browser URL length limits

## Schema

Machine-readable API schema: `/agent-schema.json`

## HTTP API

- OpenAPI: `/openapi.json`
- Capabilities: `/api/agent/capabilities`
- Unknown paths return HTTP 404 (JSON when `Accept: application/json`)
